The Punjab High Court has appointed a Warrant Officer to monitor the Enforcement Directorate's ongoing searches, responding to a request for intervention from the state government. The court‑ordered oversight is intended to ensure that the raids are conducted within legal parameters.

The ED raids have focused on a Punjab government body in Mohali, the office of a senior official alleged to be involved in a building scam, and the residence of AAP minister Hardeep Mundian’s nephew in Ludhiana. These actions have ignited a political dispute between the Aam Aadmi Party‑led state government and the central government.
